project.name: DMP :: Connector :: Salesforce Bulk API 2.0
project.description: Reads and writes Salesforce through Bulk API 2.0. A chunk is one bulk job: records are staged to disk as CSV, uploaded once, and the job is then polled to completion — which is why this connector needs the asynchronous half of the SPI that a database connector never touches. Per-record outcomes are fetched from the job's own failed-results file, so a rejection names the record Salesforce refused rather than only the count.
